title: Controls Symphony: Access, Procurement & Operational Patterns
author: Isha Raman
body:
Purpose

This playbook unifies the company-wide operational controls for access and permissions, change management, data handling, procurement & expenses, vendor lifecycle, travel approvals, and reusable templates. It is intended for cross-functional use (Engineering, Security, Finance, People Ops, and GTM) to reduce friction, shorten approval cycles, and ensure auditable, repeatable decisions.

Scope

- Applies to all Redwood systems, cloud accounts, and corporate processes.
- Covers identity and access provisioning, privileged access, approved change windows, data classification and retention, procurement up to $2M, vendor onboarding and offboarding, and company travel expense policies.

Principles (summary)

- Least privilege by default: grant only what’s needed for 90-day periods.
- Separation of duties: approvals require distinct reviewers for budget/technical/security where applicable.
- Traceability: every access/grant/change/procurement decision must have a ticket (Jira/Concur/Contract ID).
- Risk-tiered controls: higher risk → stricter approvals and mandatory security review.

Ownership matrix

| Domain | Primary owner | Secondary owner | SLA for requests |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Access & Permissions | Identity & Access Team | Team Engineering Manager | 3 business days (standard) / 8 hours (urgent) |
| Change Management | Platform Ops | Service Owner | 48 hours pre-notice for standard changes |
| Data Management | Data Governance | Security | 5 business days for classification requests |
| Procurement & Expenses | Finance Ops | Requesting Manager | 5 business days for approvals under $25k |
| Vendor Management | Procurement | Legal | 10 business days for standard vendors |
| Travel & Expenses | People Ops / Finance | Manager | 3 business days prior for international travel |

Access & Permissions (detailed)

1) Onboarding/Offboarding

- New hire access is initiated from People Ops via the Onboarding Jira template (ONB-Create-Access). Identity & Access provisions core accounts (Okta, GCP, AWS, GitHub) after background check and completion of policy acknowledgements.
- Offboarding checklist (mandatory): revoke SSO sessions, remove SSH keys, disable cloud console roles, rotate shared keys if user had privileged access, and log completion in ONB-Offboard ticket.

2) Role-based access and temporary elevation

- Define roles in the Roles Catalog (roles.redwood.internal). Use IAM groups mapped to job functions.
- For temporary privileged access (break-glass), request through the BreakGlass form; approvals required from Service Owner + Security Approver. Maximum duration: 8 hours. All activity must be audited and forwarded to Security within 24 hours.

3) Privileged key management

- Never store non-rotating private keys in user home directories. Use Vault (hashicorp) for secrets and HSM/KMS for production server keys. Automatic rotation schedule: 90 days for service keys, 30 days for developer tokens.

Change Management (process)

Steps for standard and emergency changes:

1. Create a change request in Jira (CHG-XXXX) with description, impacted services, rollback plan, and test plan.
2. Classify change: Standard (no downtime), Planned (may affect SLOs), Emergency (security/production incident).

Approval matrix:

- Standard change: Service Owner approval.
- Planned change: Service Owner + Platform Ops + optional Security review (if data-in-path).
- Emergency change: Triage with Oncall + Post-incident RFC within 72 hours.

Notifications:

- Planned changes with potential customer impact must be announced on #status and scheduled on the status page 48 hours prior.

Data Management (summary & configs)

Classification levels:

- Public: No restrictions.
- Internal: Company employees only.
- Confidential: Access by role; encryption at rest & in transit required.
- Regulated: PII / PHI / Financial; additional contractual controls.

Retention table:

| Data Type | Retention | Responsible |
|---|---:|---|
| Application logs (non-PII) | 90 days | Eng SRE |
| Audit logs (IAM, Admin) | 3 years | Security |
| Customer datasets (regulated) | As contract requires | Customer Success + Legal |

Data handling rules:

- All regulated and confidential data must be stored in customer-specific buckets with encryption (AES-256) and access logging enabled.
- Data exports must be approved by Data Governance and logged. Use the Data Export Request template (templates/data-export-request.md).

Procurement & Expenses (workflow & thresholds)

Quick rules:

- < $5,000: Manager approval in Concur.
- $5,000–$50,000: Manager + Finance Ops approval.
- $50,000–$500,000: Procurement + Finance Ops + Legal review (if contract).
- > $500,000: Executive procurement review + Legal + CFO sign-off.

Process (numbered):

1. Create a Purchase Request (PR) in Procurement tracker with business justification, preferred vendor, and budget code.
2. Finance Ops validates budget and assigns spend category.
3. Procurement engages vendor, negotiates terms, and routes contract to Legal if any custom terms.
4. PO issued only after approvals are complete.

Expense policy highlights:

- Per diem and travel class are defined in the Travel section. Receipts required for expenses > $25. Reimbursement submitted in Concur within 60 days. Expenses submitted after 120 days may be denied.

Vendor Management (lifecycle)

Vendor risk tiers:

- Tier A (Critical): Access to production systems or regulated data. Mandatory SOC2/ISO assessment and annual review.
- Tier B (Standard): Business tools with no regulated data access. Annual attestation.
- Tier C (Low): Non-critical vendors (marketing assets, event services). Procurement checklist only.

Onboarding checklist:

- Business case and sponsor identified.
- Security questionnaire completed (vendor-security-questionnaire-v2.xlsx).
- Contract template used: contracts/vendor-standard-agreement.docx.
- Validate insurance and IP clauses.

Offboarding checklist:

- Revoke vendor credentials and SSO.
- Disable API keys and rotate any shared secrets.
- Archive contract and record termination date.

Travel & Expenses (summary)

- Booking: Use Redwood Travel Portal (Concur). Manager approval required for air travel. Economy preferred under 6 hours; Premium Economy permitted for flights over 10 hours with manager consent.
- International travel: submit itinerary and local emergency contact 10 business days prior. Security review required for travel to high-risk countries (see Travel Risk Matrix).
- Expense categories: meals, lodging, ground transport, incidentals. Alcohol must be reasonable and documented.

Templates and Reusable Artifacts

- templates/onboarding-access-checklist.md
- templates/data-export-request.md
- templates/vendor-security-questionnaire-v2.xlsx
- templates/purchase-request-form.json
- templates/travel-itinerary-declaration.txt

Governance & Continuous Improvement

- Quarterly review cadence: Owners will meet monthly and produce a consolidated control report quarterly for the Audit Committee.
- Key metrics tracked: average access request time, number of emergency changes, procurement cycle time, vendor risk remediation rate. Target goals: access requests <= 3 days (90th percentile), procurement cycle <= 10 business days for <$50k.

Audit & Evidence collection

- Required evidence: Jira change tickets, Concur expense records, signed contracts, IAM grant logs, Vault access logs. Store evidence links in the Control Evidence tracker (controls-evidence.redwood.internal).

Appendix A — Example change request (sample JSON)

{
  "change_id": "CHG-2029-0001",
  "service": "inference-runtime",
  "type": "planned",
  "owner": "eng-platform@redwood.internal",
  "scheduled_window": "2029-02-17T02:00:00Z",
  "rollback_plan": "revert image tag to v1.12.3 and restart service",
  "test_plan": "smoke tests (latency < 150ms) and synthetic traffic at 10% of normal",
  "approvals": ["service-owner", "platform-ops", "security-if-data-in-path"]
}

Appendix B — Quick CLI snippets

- Revoke AWS role (example): aws iam remove-role-from-instance-profile --instance-profile-name prod-app --role-name temp-debug-role
- Vault read (example): vault kv get secret/service/prod-db-creds

Frequently asked questions

Q: Who can approve vendor contracts?
A: Procurement can approve standard contracts up to $50k. Legal review required for custom terms. Executive approval required above $500k.

Q: What to do for product emergency changes during off hours?
A: Execute emergency change with Oncall and document in CHG ticket; produce post-incident RFC within 72 hours.
